title: CVS Caremark small-group offering operating agent catalog

domains.name: Commercial and client management
domains.commercialPurpose: Sell and retain the highly automated, transparent CVS Caremark Glass offering for small group employers.

processes.name: Market opportunity qualification
processes.description: Qualify small group employer opportunities for the CVS Caremark Glass offering against approved group eligibility, funding arrangements, channel, launch geography, and service economics.
controls: Use approved scoring weights and current pipeline permissions

processes.name: RFP response management
processes.description: Prepare evidence-backed small-group employer and broker proposals, standard questionnaires, and RFP responses for the Caremark Glass offering.
controls: No unsupported capability, guarantee, or security claim

failureHandling.fallback: Assign unanswered items to human owners

processes.name: Proposal pricing and underwriting
processes.description: Compare approved Caremark TrueCost and drug-level rebate configurations using 100% rebate pass-through, separately disclosed fees, net cost, and cost to serve.
inputs: Approved Caremark TrueCost or drug-level rebate terms and small-group product eligibility

conditions: all external prices and nonstandard terms

controls: Margin floors, delegated limits, and independent model checks
Require 100% rebate pass-through and separately disclosed service fees; prohibit retained-rebate economics

failureHandling.escalation: Model or data variance to finance

processes.name: Contract negotiation and configuration
processes.description: Translate approved Caremark small-group terms into versioned pricing-model selection, 100% rebate pass-through, fees, benefit packages, member rebate elections, and obligations.
inputs: Approved Caremark TrueCost or drug-level rebate terms and small-group product eligibility
controls: Clause playbook, signing authority, and obligation reconciliation
Require 100% rebate pass-through and separately disclosed service fees; prohibit retained-rebate economics

failureHandling.recovery: Issue approved amendment or corrected configuration

processes.name: Client performance and renewal
processes.description: Track contractual value, guarantees, satisfaction, risks, and renewal options across the client lifecycle.
controls: Use contract-specific definitions and certified data

domains.name: Implementation and eligibility
domains.commercialPurpose: Launch contracted benefits accurately and maintain timely, auditable member enrollment.

processes.name: Implementation requirements and design
processes.description: Map small-group employer requirements to approved Caremark benefit packages, eligibility integrations, pricing models, and repeatable launch workflows.
controls: Every contractual obligation maps to an owner and test

processes.name: Benefit and group configuration
processes.description: Configure groups, plans, networks, formularies, cost shares, accumulators, and effective dates from approved design.

authoritativeCalculation.system: benefit configuration compiler and rules engine

approval.authority: Configuration lead and client benefit owner

controls: Four-eyes review and effective-dated immutable versions

failureHandling.recovery: Correct, recompile, and rerun regression suite

processes.name: Eligibility ingestion and reconciliation
processes.description: Validate, match, apply, and reconcile enrollment transactions while preserving effective-dated coverage history.

tools.name: eligibility-gateway
tools.scope: validate and apply authorized enrollment changes

conditions: termination, retroactive loss, or unmatched sponsor instruction

controls: Idempotency, control totals, effective dating, and termination hold

failureHandling.fallback: Quarantine invalid batch without partial commit

processes.name: Eligibility reject resolution
processes.description: Diagnose rejected enrollment instructions and propose or apply evidence-backed reversible corrections.

sla.escalation: Aged or access-impacting case to manager

controls: Never invent member data; human authority for termination

metrics.name: rejects resolved within one business day

failureHandling.fallback: Return to sponsor with precise defect
failureHandling.escalation: Urgent access issue to rapid response
failureHandling.recovery: Reverse correction and replay source instruction

processes.name: Launch testing and certification
processes.description: Execute end-to-end claim, eligibility, accumulator, financial, reporting, and service acceptance tests before go-live.

authoritativeCalculation.system: claims and financial calculation engines under test

controls: No critical open defects; representative positive and negative cases

failureHandling.escalation: Any critical defect to go-live committee
failureHandling.recovery: Fix and rerun impacted regression set

domains.name: Claims and benefit administration
domains.commercialPurpose: Adjudicate pharmacy transactions accurately in real time and maintain defensible benefit outcomes.

processes.name: Real-time transaction intake
processes.description: Authenticate, normalize, validate, deduplicate, and route NCPDP pharmacy transactions.
controls: Authentication, replay protection, schema validation, and idempotency

processes.name: Benefit adjudication
processes.description: Determine eligibility, coverage, utilization edits, network status, price, cost share, and accumulators.
controls: Only effective approved rules; exact decimal arithmetic; full decision trace

failureHandling.fallback: Safe reject or approved continuity mode

processes.name: Accumulator management
processes.description: Maintain deductible, out-of-pocket, benefit maximum, and cross-vendor accumulator balances.

trigger.event: Claim, reversal, adjustment, or external accumulator received

tools.name: accumulator-ledger
tools.scope: balanced postings tied to claim events

sla.target: Real time for claims; daily for external reconciliation

controls: Balanced postings, idempotency, and no direct balance mutation

failureHandling.fallback: Queue posting and prevent double application

processes.name: Claim adjustment and reprocessing
processes.description: Correct claim outcomes through reversals, replacements, mass reprocessing, and balanced financial adjustments.

trigger.event: Approved correction, reversal, or systemic defect identified

tools.name: claims-reprocessor
tools.scope: approved claim set and pinned rules version

sla.escalation: Material exposure to executive incident team

controls: Dry run, impact threshold, dual approval, and compensating entries

processes.name: Claim inquiry and explanation
processes.description: Explain an adjudicated outcome from the exact rule trace without recomputing or inventing figures.

trigger.event: Authorized stakeholder asks about a claim

tools.name: claim-explainer
tools.scope: authorized claim and rule trace only

controls: Figures copied from authoritative output; minimum-necessary access

failureHandling.fallback: State unavailable and open supported case
failureHandling.recovery: Send corrected explanation after authoritative correction

domains.name: Clinical programs and utilization management
domains.commercialPurpose: Apply evidence-based clinical policy while protecting timely access, due process, and licensed clinical authority.

processes.name: Prior authorization intake
processes.description: Normalize requests, extract evidence with citations, identify missing information, and build the criteria answer set.
evidence: quoted source for every populated answer
controls: Unsupported answers remain blank; model cannot approve or deny

failureHandling.fallback: Manual intake with source document attached
failureHandling.escalation: Missing urgent evidence to clinical queue
failureHandling.recovery: Correct answer set with versioned audit

processes.name: Prior authorization determination
processes.description: Evaluate complete evidence against effective criteria and issue an approval or licensed adverse determination.

tools.name: criteria-engine
tools.scope: evaluate published criteria and record reviewer authority

conditions: denial, partial approval, or clinical exception

sla.target: Within applicable standard or expedited deadline

controls: Only approved effective criteria; no model-issued adverse decision

processes.name: Clinical appeals and grievances
processes.description: Triage, independently review, decide, and notify clinical appeals and grievances under due-process rules.

tools.name: appeals-case-system
tools.scope: case chronology, evidence, conflicts, and notices

controls: Reviewer independence, complete record, and jurisdiction calendar

failureHandling.recovery: Reopen with independent review and corrected notice

processes.name: Clinical program identification and outreach
processes.description: Identify eligible members for adherence, specialty, safety, and evidence-based clinical support programs.

tools.name: clinical-program-engine
tools.scope: eligible cohort and consent-compliant outreach tasks

sla.target: Safety cases same day; other cases within 3 days

controls: Consent, do-not-contact, approved scripts, and licensed escalation

failureHandling.recovery: Correct cohort and suppress inappropriate outreach

processes.name: Drug utilization and safety surveillance
processes.description: Detect duplicate therapy, interaction, dose, misuse, and emerging safety patterns for clinical review.

trigger.event: Claim-level edit or population signal threshold met

authoritativeCalculation.system: versioned DUR and signal scoring rules

conditions: case closure, provider contact, or access restriction

sla.target: Real-time edits under claim SLA; severe retrospective signals same day
sla.escalation: Imminent harm to clinical incident lead

controls: Validated rules, false-positive monitoring, and licensed consequential action

failureHandling.fallback: Route to pharmacist without automated conclusion
failureHandling.recovery: Suppress defective rule and re-evaluate affected cases

controls: Clinical evidence precedes economics; count disruption

failureHandling.escalation: Unsafe or incomplete evidence to P&T

processes.name: Drug evidence review
processes.description: Assess comparative efficacy, safety, guidelines, and population relevance for formulary decisions.

failureHandling.fallback: Defer decision or use current policy

processes.name: P&T decision governance

tools.name: pt-governance-system
tools.scope: agenda, votes, recusals, and signed minutes

controls: Independence, quorum, conflicts, and minutes

processes.name: Formulary publication and maintenance
processes.description: Translate approved decisions into synchronized effective-dated claims rules, search, files, and notices.
controls: Single source compilation and channel reconciliation

processes.name: Formulary exception management
processes.description: Evaluate member-specific exception requests with clinical due process and timely access protections.
controls: Licensed authority and appeal rights

domains.name: Pharmacy network management

processes.name: Network strategy and access
processes.description: Design national, regional, specialty, mail, and preferred networks against access and unit-cost goals.

trigger.event: Annual design or access threshold breach

controls: Regulatory access standards and disruption limits

processes.name: Pharmacy contracting
processes.description: Negotiate and execute reimbursement, dispensing, audit, data, and service terms with pharmacies.
controls: Delegated rate limits and legal playbook

processes.name: Credentialing and enrollment
processes.description: Verify licensure, ownership, sanctions, insurance, capabilities, and identifiers before network activation.

trigger.event: Pharmacy applies or periodic recredentialing due

controls: Primary-source verification and exclusion screening

processes.name: Pharmacy performance monitoring
processes.description: Monitor access, quality, reversals, dispensing patterns, complaints, and contract performance.

trigger.event: Performance metric or integrity signal breaches threshold

processes.name: Pharmacy support and disputes

trigger.event: Scheduled MAC cycle or market threshold

evidence: input snapshot, formula version, output diff

metrics.name: MAC products with available source at or below ceiling

failureHandling.fallback: Keep prior ceiling or remove unsupported item

processes.name: Generic market surveillance

processes.name: Rebate contract strategy

approval.authority: Trade committee and P&T for clinical position

trigger.event: Eligible paid claim or contract adjustment

evidence: claim eligibility trace and formula result

sla.target: Daily accrual; month close by schedule

processes.name: Rebate invoicing and collection

processes.name: Client rebate allocation
processes.description: Reconcile 100% attributable rebate receipts to plan entitlements, member credits where elected, sponsor or issuer remittances, and unpaid balances with zero retained rebates.

trigger.event: Rebate cash, guarantee, or settlement period available

evidence: Drug-level receipt-to-entitlement-to-remittance lineage, member credits, and outstanding payable reconciliation
controls: No allocation above collected or guaranteed pool; balance to zero
Pass through 100% of attributable rebates and covered remuneration, including affiliate/GPO flows; retention must be zero
Reconcile actual receipts and true-ups; distinguish estimates and guarantees from cash
Count member point-of-sale credits once against plan entitlement; never subtract service fees from rebates
